title: Sistemas Operativos
subject: Informatics Engineering
description: Introduction to operating systems. Covers process management, CPU scheduling, memory allocation, virtual memory, concurrency, file systems, and shell programming.
syllabus_topics: Process lifecycle, states, and context switching
CPU Scheduling algorithms (FIFO, Round Robin, SJF)
Memory management, paging, and virtual memory
Concurrency, mutual exclusion, and semaphores
File systems structures and directory traversal
UNIX shell programming and terminal commands
textbooks: Modern Operating Systems by Andrew S. Tanenbaum
Operating System Concepts by Silberschatz, Galvin & Gagne
relevance: Direct equivalent to CZU Operating Systems/UNIX requirement. Instruction in English/bilingual format.

title: Tecnologias Web
subject: Informatics Engineering
description: Full-stack web development. Covers client-server architectures, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, DOM manipulation, responsive layouts, web APIs, and backend server basics.
syllabus_topics: Client-server model and HTTP/HTTPS protocols
Semantic HTML5 structure and SEO guidelines
CSS3 styling, Flexbox, Grid layouts, and responsive design
JavaScript basics, asynchronous patterns, and fetch API
DOM manipulation, event handling, and form validation
Backend server fundamentals and database connection
textbooks: Eloquent JavaScript by Marijn Haverbeke
Learning Web Design by Jennifer Robbins
relevance: Direct equivalent to CZU Web Technologies requirement. Taught/supported in English.

title: Estatística e Análise de Dados
subject: Informatics Engineering
description: Probability and data analysis. Focuses on descriptive statistics, probability distributions, sampling methods, parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, and linear regression.
syllabus_topics: Descriptive statistics and data visualization methods
Probability theory, conditional probability, and Bayes' theorem
Discrete and continuous probability distributions
Confidence intervals and hypothesis testing
Correlation analysis and linear regression modeling
Statistical software applications (R or Python)
textbooks: Applied Statistics and Probability for Engineers by Douglas C. Montgomery
Introduction to Probability and Statistics by William Mendenhall
relevance: Direct equivalent to CZU Statistics requirement. Supported in English.

title: Contabilidade Geral
subject: Economics and Management
description: General accounting systems. Covers the double-entry system, registration of business operations, general ledger recording, trial balance preparation, and financial statements.
syllabus_topics: The role of accounting in organizations and accounting standards
The double-entry system and account debit/credit rules
Recording routine commercial transactions and operations
End-of-period adjustments and depreciation/amortization
Preparation of Balance Sheets and Income Statements
Financial statement analysis overview
textbooks: Financial Accounting by Weygandt, Kimmel & Kieso
General Accounting Principles (Portuguese/EU Framework)
relevance: Direct equivalent to CZU General Accounting requirement. Offered by the Faculty of Economics with English support.

title: Sistemes Operatius
subject: Escola Politècnica Superior (EPS)
description: Operating systems engineering. Covers process management, CPU scheduling, memory hierarchies, virtual memory paging, input/output structures, file systems, and bash scripting.
syllabus_topics: Process creation, synchronization, threads, and IPC
CPU Scheduling algorithms and real-time scheduling
Memory management, paging, segmentation, and swap
Concurrency, deadlocks, semaphores, and mutexes
Virtual file systems, disk layouts, and storage management
UNIX/Linux shell environments, commands, and bash scripting
textbooks: Operating System Concepts by Silberschatz, Galvin & Gagne
Sistemes Operatius UOC/UdL Course Material
relevance: Direct match for CZU Operating Systems / UNIX requirement. 9 ECTS weight ensures full credit coverage.

title: Administració i Manteniment de Sistemes i Aplicacions
subject: Escola Politècnica Superior (EPS)
description: UNIX systems administration. Practical management of Linux/UNIX environments, server installation, configuration of web, database, mail and DNS services, security and backups.
syllabus_topics: Linux/UNIX installation, partitioning, and boot managers
User accounts, permissions, and group policy management
Configuration of network services: HTTP (Apache/Nginx), DNS, SMTP, SQL
System monitoring, performance tuning, and log analysis
Backup strategies, cron automation, and shell scripting
Firewalls, SSH security, and system hardening
textbooks: UNIX and Linux System Administration Handbook by Evi Nemeth
Linux Administration: A Beginner's Guide by Wale Soyinka
relevance: Alternative winter option for CZU UNIX/OS. Focuses heavily on Linux administration and scripting.

title: Web dinàmica
subject: Escola Politècnica Superior (EPS)
description: Dynamic web applications. Focuses on server-side web development, database connectivity (SQL/NoSQL), session management, dynamic page rendering, and security models.
syllabus_topics: Server-side languages (PHP, Node.js, or ASP.NET)
Database interaction and ORM mapping (e.g. MySQL, MongoDB)
State management, sessions, cookies, and user authentication
RESTful API design and JSON serialization
Web security: CSRF, XSS prevention, and password hashing
Deploying web applications to cloud/virtual environments
textbooks: Node.js Web Development by David Herron
Web Database Applications with PHP and MySQL by Hugh E. Williams
relevance: Winter alternative for CZU Web Technologies (Projecte Web is Spring-only). Offered in Digital Design & Creative Tech degree.

title: Disseny Centrat en l'Usuari
subject: Escola Politècnica Superior (EPS)
description: User-Centered UI/UX Design. Focuses on user interface wireframing, UX heuristics, usability testing, layout design for web/mobile, and frontend implementation.
syllabus_topics: User research, personas, and user journey mapping
Usability heuristics and interface design guidelines
Wireframing, interactive prototyping using Figma/Adobe XD
Accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive web interface design
Usability evaluation methods and user testing procedures
Frontend layout styling and UI components integration
textbooks: Don't Make Me Think by Steve Krug
The Design of Everyday Things by Don Norman
relevance: Alternative winter option for CZU Web Technologies. Focuses on web/app layout design and usability.

title: Estadística Avançada
subject: Facultat de Dret, Economia i Turisme (FDET)
description: Advanced statistical methods. Covers probability theory, statistical inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, ANOVA, correlation, and multi-variable regression models.
syllabus_topics: Probability spaces, random variables, and expectation
Sampling distributions and Central Limit Theorem
Estimation of parameters and confidence intervals
Parametric and non-parametric hypothesis testing
Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) and F-tests
Correlation and multiple linear regression modeling
textbooks: Statistics for Business and Economics by Paul Newbold
Introductory Statistics by Sheldon Ross
relevance: Winter alternative for CZU Statistics (Estadística i Optimització is Spring-only). Offered under Business Administration (ADE).

title: Fonaments de Comptabilitat
subject: Facultat de Dret, Economia i Turisme (FDET)
description: Foundations of Financial Accounting. Focuses on the accounting cycle, double-entry bookkeeping, recording operations, journal ledger entries, and financial statements preparation.
syllabus_topics: Introduction to accounting theory, standards, and regulatory frameworks
The double-entry ledger system and basic accounting equation
Recording purchases, sales, payroll, and asset acquisitions
Inventory valuation models and year-end inventory adjustments
Financial close, depreciation calculation, and tax entries
Compilation of Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss Statements
textbooks: Financial Accounting: An Introduction by Pauline Weetman
Fundamentals of Accounting (Spanish/EU Plan General Contable)
relevance: Direct match for CZU Accounting requirement. Offered by Business Administration (ADE) faculty in Winter.
